title.zh: OpenSea移动端App向公众开放，上线社交交易功能
title.en: OpenSea移动端App向公众开放，上线社交交易功能

current_state.zh: OpenSea opened its mobile app to all users, adding trading across 25+ chains for memecoins, NFTs, trading cards and perpetual futures alongside social trading features that surface and let users follow traders from fomo, pump and Farcaster, with Apple Pay wallet funding and on-chain NFT avatars.
